spaces_menu.title: Manage Spaces
spaces_menu.description: Add, edit, or delete managed living spaces.

space_add.title: Add Space
space_add.description: Configure a room or thermal zone. Spaces can have heating/cooling emitters and schedules.

data.name: Space Name
data.id: Space ID (Optional slug, auto-generated from Name)

data_description.id: Unique identifier for this space. Leave blank to auto-generate from the space name.
data_description.priority: Determines arbitration winner when multiple mini-split indoor heads sharing one outdoor unit request conflicting modes (heating vs. cooling). Higher numbers win (e.g. Priority 6 beats Priority 2).
data_description.shared_boiler_role: Select 'Independent' if this space has its own dedicated zone valve/thermostat. If multiple spaces share a single hydronic heating loop, set the space with the controlling wall thermostat to 'Primary', and spaces without thermostats to 'Secondary' (they receive passive heat when primary calls).
data_description.window_sensor: Optional binary sensor (door or window). When open, HVAC for this space will be paused.
data_description.configure_primary_emitter: Optionally attach the space's main heating or cooling emitter right away. You can add additional emitters or schedule presets anytime later from the space management menu.
data_description.hp_emitter_producer: The outdoor multi-split heat pump unit powering this indoor head.
data_description.boiler_emitter_producer: The central boiler powering this hydronic zone.
data_description.cancel: Discard input and return to the spaces menu without creating a new space.
